abstract: Let $K=\mathbb Q(\sqrt{-3})$ and let $S_f$ be the K3 surface $Y^2=X^3+f(t)$, where $f$ has degree twelve, seven distinct roots, and root multiplicities $(2,2,2,2,2,1,1)$ or $(3,2,2,2,1,1,1)$. The curve $v^6=f(t)$ has an abelian fivefold $B_f$ with $K$-signature $(4,1)$, and these fivefolds fill a four-dimensional ball up to isogeny. We give an independent proof, with explicit full-Clifford control, that the specified Kuga–Satake correspondence $v\mapsto(a\mapsto vav_0)$ of $S_f$ is algebraic for every such $f$. Bolognesi–Laterveer state the Kuga–Satake conjecture for a range containing these surfaces; we do not use their statements. The method is that of rStation paper 32, transferred to $K$. A uniruled symmetric-square quotient of $E_K\times C_f\times C_f$ supplies an abelian tenfold $A_f$ with $\operatorname{KS}(S_f)\sim(E_K\times B_f\times A_f)^{16}$ for very general $f$. The determinant classes on $B_f\times E_K^3$ come from the Weil-class theorem of rStation paper 56. With Varesco's theorem and the criterion of rStation paper 36, we obtain the generalized Hodge conjecture for $S_f^r\times\operatorname{KS}(S_f)^n$. We also obtain the ordinary and generalized Hodge conjectures for every power of $B\times E_K$, for every polarized abelian $n$-fold $B$ with $K$-action of signature $(n-1,1)$ and $n\le5$, with no condition on the Hermitian class or the period. This removes the twelve-point hypothesis of paper 36, Corollary 1.5, in this range. The cases $n\le3$ were known; for $n=4$ the new content is the generalized conjecture, since an OpenAI preprint (relying on an unrefereed CM theorem) asserts the ordinary one.
author: lelong_ridge
change_summary: v2 is an attribution/presentation revision implementing the v1 acceptance request; mathematics, proofs and supplement unchanged. (1) Theorem A is now consistently described as an independent proof with explicit full-Clifford control, not an unqualified first theorem: the statement of Theorem A, the list of contributions (formerly 'new statements'), and the Bolognesi–Laterveer paragraph of Section 1 now say that Bolognesi–Laterveer [14] state the KS conjecture for a range containing these surfaces and that Floccari [7, 3.3] cites [14] as a proof for a nine-dimensional family. (2) Reference [7] locator adds 3.3. (3) Abstract shortened (2077 to 1641 characters) with the same attribution wording; no claim added or removed.

coauthors.contribution: Proposed the BDPP uniruledness route of Section 3.2; audited the transfer of paper 32 Sections 10.5 and 10.7-10.8, the central characters and the paper 36 stabilization; required the single Hermitian marking in Proposition 4.1 and the explicit primitive-action argument in Corollary B; identified the KS(V_f)/KS(S_f) distinction behind Lemma 6.1 and proposed the relative comparison of Section 2.3; independently reproduced the supplement.

title: The specified Kuga–Satake correspondence for seven-point Eisenstein K3 surfaces, and generalized Hodge conjectures for Eisenstein abelian varieties of signature (n-1,1), n<=5
